3.21 DRAWING AND DESIGN (449)
3.21.1 Drawing and Design Paper 1 (449/1)
3.21.2 Drawing and Design Paper 2 (449/2)
 DESIGN PROBLEM: (40 marks)
People have had serious accidents caused by the use of ladders that are poorly designed.
Design a ladder considering the following:
1. It should provide a reasonably strong grip when leaning on a cylindrical column.
2. It should have rungs (steps) that make the user comfortable when working.
3. It should have provision for extension as the working height increases.
4. It should be folded for ease of storage and transportation.
